summary: Copies exactly 4 DWORDs from source pointer a2 to destination a1 by walking the source forward and writing each element to a1 + (source - a2). The source pointer is written only at offset 0 of the destination window per iteration, so each source DWORD overwrites the same destination base a1 with its value. Returns the source pointer advanced 4 DWORDs (16 bytes) past its start.

operations.description: Seed the walking pointer result = a2 (source base) and the counter v3 = 3, giving 4 loop iterations.
do-while loop over 4 DWORDs: the body runs until the countdown v3 (3,2,1) reaches zero.
Each iteration writes one source DWORD: *(a1 + (result - a2)) = *result, so the 4 source words land at destination offsets 0,4,8,12 from base a1.
Advance the walking pointer: ++result (4 bytes) and --v3 after each store.
Return the source pointer advanced 4 DWORDs past a2; the only static caller is sub_5953B8.
